key_facts: The team decided to drop the speech recognition feature.
The team agreed to keep the LCD screen and use a single curved design.
The team opted for an integrated scroll-wheel push-button instead of multiple physical buttons.
The team concluded that the design would cost 28 points on a seven-point evaluation scale.
The team discussed the use of a hand dynamo as a power source but ultimately decided against it due to energy concerns.
The team decided to use plastic with a special color for the casing.
The team determined that the remote control is not very easy to use, scoring a six on the evaluation scale.
The team evaluated the design as being better than average, scoring higher than the initial user requirements.
The team decided to rename the remote control as 'Real Remote' and incorporate the initials into the logo.
The team discussed the need for recalibration of the drawing tool during the meeting.
